generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for these costs
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E-Procurement Portal
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all Tender without assigning any reasons
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders

As per Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 1.01.2007 nad Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
Successful bidder has to furnish 0.1% of award contract amount as insurance during entering in to agreement.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the original documents before approval.
Materials required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work.
The Contractor has to establish site laboratories and should furnish the documents for having required lab testing equipments. (For works more than Rs.1.00 crore)
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Registration (CPWD registerd contractor can participate for works more than Rs.10.00 crore)
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per K.W Document.
The period of completion shall be as mentioned in KW document
The period of completion of this work is 9 Months & the eligible contractor should maintain the work for Two YEARS after the successful completion of the project.
Contractor shall bound to comply the prevailing rules and regulations with regard to the EPF Contribution rules and any modifications thereof before and after execution of agreement
Contractors has to upload the EPF Registration
Contractors has to submit their labour EPF details with every Running Bill

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in the prescribed form in the favour of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division, Hassa, given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with the Conditions of Contract.
The GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the Contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per govt Circular No:FD 417 Exp-12/2024, Banglore Dtd:09.08.2024 and prevailing GST (18% of amount put to tender) amount is kept in form of Lumpsum in sanctioned estimate. Therefore amount put to tender and ECV amount are excluding GST. But the itemwise rates do not include GST. Hence GST will be paid separately for the Executed amount accordingly.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured according to ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (EMS ISO 14001:2015) & QUALITY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (QMS ISO 9001:2015) Policies, so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
Formation levels and other data furnished are bare minimum, the contractor should make all efforts to validate and to get additional data if required at his own cost.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing public/ private properties which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.

Contractor should adhere to HSE (Health Safety Environment) policy applicable for similar projects. Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project.

Bankers Certificate for the stipulated amount as per clause 3.3 (b) should be submitted in the format as prescribed in the bid document (Section-3 Clause 1.1) only. Otherwise tender is liable for rejection.
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the KW Standard Tender documents.

Regarding Appealing aggrieved contractor may appeal to the prescribed (Appellant) Authority within 30 days as per KTTP and appeal should be trough eproc only as per Govt: Order No.pwd/572/CRN-2020 Bangalore Dt:09.10.2020. same will not be considered if appeal through Letters.
The FSD payable at the time of executing agreement, will be refunded only after successful completion of Defect Liability Period
The Contractor has to establish Field laboratories and should furnish the documents for having required lab testing equipments.

Confirmations to LOC and work done Certificates uploaded in e-Proc should be received to this office, EE, PWD, HASSAN DIVISION, within 15days from the date of receipt of confirmation request letters to concerned Departments/Banks, otherwise LOC and Work done will be considered as, Not Confirmed and Bids will be Considered for Rejection.

The quantities for the necessary deviation road and cofferdam are provided on a onetime basis in the BOQ and any additional quantities required for complition of the work shall deemed included in the contractors rates no extra payments may be admissible. And such works shall be executed at the Contractors own cost and risk.
